text_block_list.text:
One day, while getting ready
to grab a meal in the cafeteria—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Limited to 10 Servings! Special Mont Blanc"――
But... the calories...
choice_data_list: You're making quite a face, are you okay?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Eek!? Y-You're……
Jeez, please don't scare me like that!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Setting that aside, I have a consultation for you!
It's about me... well, actually, about a friend of mine...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I hear that people often end up
unable to endure strict dietary restrictions.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: She apparently understands that it's necessary for the upcoming race, but...
choice_data_list: Hang in there and endure until the race is over.
No problem as long as you run off what you ate.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Y-You are quite right!
Once a decision is made, perseverance is paramount.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for the advice!
I will pass it along to my... well, to a friend!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes, indeed! I was thinking the exact same thing!
Holding back too much is bad for one's health, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Just a tiny bit, then.
We can savor the rest properly later...♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for the advice!
I will pass it along to my... well, to a friend!
